_doc: Staff system (StaffManager / EmployeeAI): specializations, traits, ethics, candidate generation.

general.name: General practice
general.text: Steady hands for everyday chrome. Not brilliant at anything, rarely a disaster.

neural.name: Neural surgery
neural.text: Nerve splicing and lattice work. Fewer seizures, fewer patients who forget their own names.

trauma.name: Trauma
trauma.text: Gunshots, blades, crush injuries. Calm when the floor is red.

cyber_limb.name: Cyber-limbs
cyber_limb.text: Half mechanic, half surgeon. Anchors, actuators, socket fits.

black_market.name: Black-market work
black_market.text: Knows unregistered chrome, scrubbed serials and how to install things that shouldn't fit.

military.name: Military medicine
military.text: Field surgery under fire. Fast, unsentimental, reliable with combat chrome.

experimental.name: Experimental
experimental.text: Trained in labs that don't exist anymore. Good at everything, honest about nothing.

idealist.name: Idealist
idealist.text: Believes street medicine can be real medicine. Refuses black-market chrome unless deeply loyal.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.text: Fast and careless: -5% success, never refuses a job, stress builds slowly.

perfectionist.name: Perfectionist
perfectionist.text: +5% success, but every job costs extra stress.

money_only.name: Money first
money_only.text: Won't touch jobs paying under 250. Expects a bigger salary.

hates_corps.name: Hates corps
hates_corps.text: Refuses corporate and Lyra clients. Forcing it costs loyalty.

secret_agent.name: Informant
secret_agent.text: Reports to a faction. Leaks your business and raises heat until discovered.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.text: Debts of their own. Money sometimes goes missing from the till.

stim_user.name: Stim user
stim_user.text: Works through anything, until they don't: results swing wildly.

loyal.name: Loyal
loyal.text: Sticks with you. Loyalty never drops below 40.

ambitious.name: Ambitious
ambitious.text: Wants more: asks for raises as skills grow and leaves if ignored.

night_owl.name: Night owl
night_owl.text: Takes one extra job a day.

gentle.name: Gentle bedside manner
gentle.text: Patients trust them: +1 reputation on good jobs.

no_minors.name: No minors
no_minors.text: Will not put chrome into anyone under 18.

no_harvest.name: No black-market chrome
no_harvest.text: Will not install unregistered or harvested chrome.

no_corps.name: No corporate work
no_corps.text: Will not operate on corporate or Lyra clients.

general: Ran a free clinic out of a laundromat until the landlord sold the building.
Twenty years patching up dockhands; knows every cheap implant by the sound it makes.
Struck off by the Medical Board for treating the wrong people. Doesn't regret it.
neural: Former Lyra lattice technician who walked out after a trial went quiet.
Self-taught from pirated surgical streams and a lot of practice on the dead.
Used to fix memory implants for the Velvet Tier's discreet clientele.
trauma: Ten years in a Sump emergency ward that no longer exists.
Rustline field medic: bullets out, chrome in, no questions.
Worked the flood-line rescue boats. Has pulled people out of water and worse.
cyber_limb: Foundry maintenance tech who started fitting arms when the union stopped paying for them.
Builds prosthetics from scrap in a garage on the Furnace Line.
Ex-factory floor; lost a hand, built a better one, then built them for everyone else.
black_market: Cuts serials for the Undermarket and installs what comes back.
Learned surgery in a shipping container from a ripper who died owing money.
Knows who sells harvested chrome and refuses to say whether they ever did.
military: Aegis Meridian field surgeon until a contract went bad on the drowned edge.
Mercenary medic with three wars' worth of muscle memory.
Ran a forward aid post during the flood riots. Still flinches at sirens.
experimental: Worked in a Restricted Zone lab. The lab was flooded. The records were not recovered.
Corporate prodigy who left with patents in their head and nothing in their pockets.
Says they 'consulted' on THREAD. Changes the subject quickly.
